options.name: all
options.description: Dump all records, including those which might otherwise be filtered or modified by a custom manager.

options.name: apps_models
options.description: Dump only the applications and models listed in the dump. Format must be either V(app_label) or V(app_label.ModelName). If not passed, all applications and models are to be dumped.

options.name: database
options.description: Specify the database to be used.

options.name: excludes
options.description: Applications or models to be excluded. Format must be either V(app_label) or V(app_label.ModelName).

options.name: fixture
options.description: Path to the output file. The fixture filename may end with V(.bz2), V(.gz), V(.lzma) or V(.xz), in which case the corresponding compression format is used. This corresponds to the C(--output) parameter for the C(django-admin dumpdata) command.

options.name: format
options.description: Serialization format of the output data.

options.name: indent
options.description: Indentation size for the output. Default is not to indent, so the output is generated in one single line.

options.name: natural_foreign
options.description: Use natural keys when serializing for foreign keys.

options.name: primary_keys
options.description: List of primary keys to include in the dump. Only available when dumping one single model.

options.name: pythonpath
options.description: Adds the given filesystem path to the Python import search path. The value is passed as is to the C(--pythonpath) argument in C(django-admin).

options.name: settings
options.description: Specifies the settings module to use. The value is passed as is to the C(--settings) argument in C(django-admin).

options.name: skip_checks
options.description: Skips running system checks prior to running the command.

options.name: traceback
options.description: Provides a full stack trace in the output when a C(CommandError) is raised.

options.name: venv
options.description: Use the Python interpreter from this virtual environment. Pass the path to the root of the virtualenv, not the C(bin/) directory nor the C(python) executable.

options.name: verbosity
options.description: Specifies the amount of notification and debug information in the output of C(django-admin).
